versions.content: The EventWindowTime will end at the end of the current power cycle if all of the following conditions are fulfilled: • The EventWindowTime is set to infinity (0x02) during the setup request • The RoeEvent was started in default-session • The storageState was not set in the StartResponseOnEvent request
